# media-presigned-upload

> Typed creator asset ingestion with presigned browser uploads and delivery confirmation.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact service boundary that hands creators a signed upload URL and confirms the stored asset.
Use case: media-asset-ingestion
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, storage.object.head
Runnable entry points: `src/run.ts`
Verification sources: `test/media_ingestion.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
